summary: Urdu script mein bani country documentaries, student lists aur Canada vs Australia jaise baray muqablay zabardast views le rahe hain. Doosri taraf food guides, Roman Urdu titles aur mukhtasir salary/visa shorts bilkul flop ho chukay hain. Hum ne nakam topics aur Roman titles band karke long documentaries aur Tier-1 country comparisons par poora focus kar diya hai.

tips: Always write titles and primary hooks in proper Urdu script; Roman Urdu titles completely flopped (x0.19 vs x10.52 for the exact same Canada vs Australia topic).
Prioritize in-depth long-form documentaries and country overviews (pk_country avg 4.12, pk_best_list 1.05) over micro-shorts, as long-form reliably outperforms short-form on average (0.87 vs 0.59).
Completely stop food-related guides (pk_food avg 0.30) and standalone salary/cost shorts (pk_salary_short 0.48, pk_cost_short 0.45), as audiences are ignoring them.
For short-form, focus strictly on fascinating national facts (China facts x11.77) and fast-paced visual tours (Singapore tour x3.95) with curiosity-driven hooks like 'ناقابل یقین اور حیران کن'.
Focus versus/comparison videos strictly on high-demand Tier-1 migration destinations (Canada vs Australia, Norway vs Denmark) and eliminate low-interest pairings like Germany vs Italy.
